mapper.select: SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, employee_num AS employeeNum, employee_password AS password, initial_state AS initialState FROM employee WHERE employee_num = #{employeeNum}
SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, employee_num AS employeeNum, employee_password AS password, initial_state AS initialState FROM employee WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
SELECT r.role_code FROM employee_role er JOIN role r ON r.role_id = er.role_id WHERE er.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_num AS employeeNum, e.employee_name AS employeeName, o.org_name AS orgName, p.position_name AS positionName, r.rank_name AS rankName, j.job_name AS jobName FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = h.org_id LEFT JOIN `position` p ON p.position_id = h.position_id LEFT JOIN `rank` r ON r.rank_id = h.rank_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = h.job_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId} LIMIT 1
SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, employee_num AS employeeNum, resident_number_hash AS residentNumberHash FROM employee WHERE employee_num = #{employeeNum}
